description: email.rs parse_header_property() lines 143-167: when parts[1] == "all", the code immediately returns (HeaderForm::Raw, true) without checking whether parts[2] exists. So 'header:Subject:all:garbage' is accepted as a valid Raw/all property request instead of being rejected. RFC 8621 §4.1.3 specifies only two suffix forms: ':all' and ':{form}' optionally followed by ':all'. A property like 'header:Name:all:extra' is syntactically invalid and should return invalidArguments. Trigger: Email/get with properties=["header:Subject:all:garbage"]. Bad behavior: request succeeds; :garbage is silently ignored.
title: parse_header_property accepts 'header:Name:all:extra' — extra suffix silently ignored
